title: Studio: the RLS predicate field keeps showing the previous draft's server error under newly edited text
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). It sits beside the #26858 / PR #26999 design, in which the field shows the draft's server verdict at its own path.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. Create a writable package (`POST /api/v1/packages {"id":"com.qa.rten","name":"QA","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qar"}`), an object `qar_job` with number `est_hours` and a formula field `f_formula`, and a permission set `qar_job_editor` with an RLS policy on `qar_job`.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.qa.rten/access`, select the set, then the Row-level security tab.
3. Type `record.f_formula > 5` into USING. Autosave runs, and the server verdict (INVALID_FIELD, virtual formula field) appears under the field. That part is correct.
4. Now change the text to a predicate the client lint holds, for example `record.est_hours * 2 > 10` (not lowerable). The client error appears and the save is held.
5. Expected: only the error that applies to the current text.
6. Actual: the previous draft's server error, which is about `f_formula` and text no longer in the field, stays rendered beside the new client error. Two different errors show at once.

## Mechanism
The server verdict at the field's path comes from the last saved draft read. A held save never re-reads, so the stale verdict is not cleared when the text changes.
